summary: Statue Island is an island on Giant's Deep housing the Nomai Statue Workshop where Daz and Phlox built the Nomai Memory Statues. The workshop's broken door is bypassed via a hole in the floor above or by swimming up from the ocean below.

behavior: Cyclones occasionally fling Statue Island into the upper atmosphere; cyclone shelters dot the island.
Rarely, a cyclone can drag Statue Island underwater instead of up into space, making it nearly impossible to navigate.
location: Statue Island is located on Giant's Deep.
Statue Island consists of two landmasses connected by a natural stone arch.
The smaller landmass contains a gravity landing pad and a warp receiver connected to the Ash Twin warp tower.
The larger landmass contains a ruined settlement and is connected to the smaller by the arch or a gravity crystal path.
The Statue Workshop is built underneath the larger landmass, below the settlement.
The larger landmass is dome-shaped, with the Workshop forming a ring around the underside opening into the ocean below.
The Workshop has a single sealed entrance at the bottom of the gravity crystal path, broken from the outside.
The settlement above the Workshop has a hole in the floor, through which a Scout can be fired to view inside.
The Workshop can be entered by swimming or flying up through the ocean opening at the dome's center.
A platform inside the Workshop is too high to reach via jetpack under Giant's Deep gravity but can be briefly reached when a cyclone flings the island into space.
lore: The Nomai Daz and Phlox created the Nomai Memory Statues in the Workshop.
Phlox welcomed visitors at the Workshop entrance and worked in his nearby dwelling when not in the Workshop.
Phlox forbade child Nomai from entering the Workshop during the dangerous memory-statue test.
Lami proposed sneaking into the test via the alternative route; Taget and Laevi refused.
Daz designed the memory storage prototype kept within Ash Twin.
Each Memory Statue pairs with a single Nomai by choosing whoever is in closest proximity during activation.
A paired statue's eyes open, indicating it has bonded to that Nomai.
Once paired, the statue records the Nomai's memories anywhere in the star system and sends them to the Ash Twin Project.
Each Nomai's stored memories live in a unique storage unit inside Ash Twin equipped with a mask, the statue's counterpart.
Ramie installed the masks inside the Ash Twin Project.
Statues are designed not to pair until the Ash Twin Project succeeds, sparing Nomai from prolonged time loops.
As a safety fail-safe, statues will also pair in the event of Ash Twin Project equipment failure to make Nomai aware of the situation.
Phlox once debated with Daz and Cassava whether sending memories back in time is the same as sending the being itself back in time.
Outside the sealed Workshop door, the Memory Statue that paired with Gabbro can be found with its eyes open.
The Workshop's warp platform notes that the arrival time is always one hundred-thousandth of a second earlier than the departure time.
